mapper.sql: SELECT e.enrollment_id, e.student_id, e.class_id, e.enroll_date, e.end_date, e.status_code, e.created_at, u.name AS student_name, s.student_no, c.class_name, c.subject FROM enrollments e JOIN students s ON s.student_id = e.student_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id JOIN classes c ON c.class_id = e.class_id
